title: You Don't Have to Build Alone | Ep 199 Most People Don't (Ulric Musset)
description:
AI tools for small business owners are changing the way entrepreneurs save time, find leads, answer emails, and grow without hiring a full team right away.

In this episode of Most People Don’t, Bart Berkey sits down with Uric Musset, founder of Marbalism, a platform built around AI employees for business. Uric shares his founder story, from building websites as a kid in France to creating a tool designed to help entrepreneurs reclaim their time and focus on what they do best.

Bart and Uric talk about AI tools for entrepreneurs, email overload, virtual assistants, sales outreach, AI receptionists, content creation, and the very human side of building something useful.

This is not just a conversation about technology. It is a conversation about creation, support, validation, business growth, and remembering that you do not have to build alone.

If this conversation reminded you that you do not have to build alone, take one step today. Look at the tasks stealing your time. Find one thing you can simplify, delegate, or improve. And if you want to try Marbalism for yourself, use the affiliate link and discount code in the show notes. If you want more conversations that help you grow, serve, lead, and do what most people don’t, subscribe to Most People Don’t.
